title: A register action on a configuration
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration with $m$ Boolean work tapes, state set $\Lambda$, and fixed input $x$. Given states $s,s'\in\Lambda$, a register $r\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, a tape function $f:\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\})$, a position $p\in\mathbb Z$, a write instruction $w\in\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Option}(\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}))$, and movement $mv\in\{-1,0,1\}$, applying the action that performs $w$ on register $r$, moves its head by $mv$, and enters $s'$ to the configuration obtained from $c$ by setting its state to $s$, register $r$'s tape to $f$, and its head position to $p$ gives the configuration with state $s'$, tape $f$ if $w$ is absent and otherwise $f$ updated at $p$ with the specified optional symbol, and head position $p+mv$. All other configuration data are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $c$ for $m$ Boolean work tapes, state set $\Lambda$, and input $x$
